## Speaker
Yiyi Wan

### Theme
An Invitation to Topological Orders and Category Theory (5)

### Abstract
We study gapped 0d domain walls between 1d topological orders. We then introduce the notion of condensation completion and the topological skeleton of a 2d topological order. From the perspective of anyon condensation, we explain how all gapped boundaries, domain walls, and defect sectors can be organized into a unified categorical framework.
